groups.title: Expandable Version: Required Courses
groups.note: Note: Credit cannot be received for both MATH 236 and MATH 223 (listed as a required course in the non-expandable version of this Minor concentration).

rules.title: Students selecting the expandable version of this program complete 6 credits of complementary courses from the Complementary Course List
It is strongly recommended that students take MATH 323 as a complementary course

groups.title: Non-Expandable Version: Required Courses
groups.note: Note: Credit cannot be received for both MATH 223 and MATH 236 (listed as a required course in the expandable version of this Minor concentration).

rules.title: Students selecting the non-expandable version of this program complete 9 credits of complementary courses from the Complementary Course List
It is strongly recommended that students take MATH 323 as a complementary course
